scripts.deploy: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote && wrangler deploy
scripts.dev:worker: pnpm build:web && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local && wrangler dev

DB.description: D1 database with the organization's settings, admins, instances, players and news.

BLOBS.description: R2 bucket with the instance files, logos and images, stored by sha256.

SESSION_SECRET.description: 32+ random characters, e.g. the output of `openssl rand -hex 32`.

JWT_SECRET.description: 32+ random characters, different from `SESSION_SECRET`. Signs player tokens and download links: changing it signs every player out.
